column1: Choose a colorblind-friendly palette (Okabe-Ito / viridis, etc.); avoid red-green contrast
Add redundant encoding beyond color (shape, line style, pattern, direct labels)
Still distinguishable after grayscale printing (checked in the second panel here)
Font size: >= 18pt body text on a projector, >= 12pt chart annotations
Don't convey up/down or good/bad with color alone (red-green is the worst)
Provide alt text for every chart (one sentence stating the conclusion)
Interactive charts should offer keyboard-accessible filtering and zoom
